decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a low-risk design variant of the core drainage business and still fits the firm's aesthetic positioning, so it is likely to remain in the portfolio.
The shower channel for seamless coverings matches modern bathroom design demand and sits squarely in the firm's established core range, making withdrawal unlikely.

The pump-assisted shower drainage solution is more specialised and complex than standard drains, but it supports barrier-free and difficult-installation applications that fit the firm's innovation path.
The tileable floor drain with grating is closely aligned with the firm's mainstream drainage offer and should remain a solid part of the assortment.
The stainless steel design drain grate is a straightforward extension of the design-led range and is unlikely to be removed unless demand proves clearly weak.
The newer pump-drain shower channel carries some launch and niche-market risk, but it builds directly on the firm's technical drainage capabilities and future-ready bathroom strategy.
